title: mera veer hussain
body:
mera veer hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
haaye haaye
armaan reya armaan reya kyun baad hussain ye jahaan reya
mazlum da sadqa salle ala
imaan reya quraan reya
armaan reya
<<MINI>>
hay hussain hay hay hussain
hussain hay hussain hay hay hussain
kar zainab ro ro bain
o mera veer hussain hayo mera veer hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
teri laash hai jalti reti par
dil paata nahi hai chain
<<MINI>>
o mera veer hussain
hussain hai hussain hai hai hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ay bhaayi mere bari mehnat se
maa zahra ne paala hai tujhe
mein dekh nahi sakti bhayya
aankhon se lahu tera behte
tere khun ke ek ek qatre par
qurbaan karun daarain
<<MINI>>
o mera veer hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
jalti hai zamine karbobala
hai chur badan tera zakhmon se
naazon ke pale kund khanjar se
zaalim ne kiya hai qatl tujhe
is zulm pe tarpa to hoga
qalbe shaahe qaunain
<<MINI>>
o mera veer hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
khaime ke dar se maqtal tak
sattar qadmon ki duri thi
is waaste baahar aa na saki
mujhe parde ki majburi thi
ummat ne kiya sajde me zibah
zahra ka nure ain
<<MINI>>
o mera veer hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
teri laash ko mein dafna na saki
mein tujhko kafan pehna na saki
ye dard mujhe tarpaayega
mein tera sog mana na saki
afsos ke doshe risaalat ka
hai khaak pe zeb o zain
<<MINI>>
o mera veer hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
jo tune kiya tha nana se
wo vaada aaj nibhaaya hai
sar sajde me katwaaya hai
khaaliq ka deen bachaaya hai
hai aaj ke baad zamaane me
islam tumhaari dain
<<MINI>>
o mera veer hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
mazlum di pyaasi gardan te
jado khanjar shimr chalaaya hai
tatheer di vaaris bibi ne
quraan te sar te jaaya hai
khaime pe dar do kardi rayi
fariyaad hussain di behn
<<MINI>>
o mera veer hussain
hussain hay hussain hay hay hussain
kar zainab ro ro bain
o mera veer hussain hayo mera veer hussain
hussain hay hussain hay hay hussain
